sample_source.evidence: The HL-60 cells were cultured in Isocove’s modified Dulbecco’s medium (IMDM, Gibco) supplemented with 10% v/v heat-inactivated fetal bovine serum (Atlanta Biologicals) at 37 °C with 5% CO2 atmosphere and treated with 225 μM Zn or deionized water.
